_comment: Laptop overfit sanity run 1 of 3 (scripts/run_overfit_tests.cmd): the real 0.6B student on ~1 s of train audio (a seeded subset of the kept reazon_small/emilia_yodas/galgame train rows; the exact ids are the `subset` events) for 1000 epochs = 1000 optimizer steps (step_audio_s >= the subset: one step per epoch), with an eval after every epoch on ~1 s of the pooled gate eval sets (teacher-forced + greedy) and a probe on the train subset itself (teacher-forced + greedy). Expect eval/probe/all/kl -> ~0 and eval/probe_greedy/all/cer_teacher_corpus -> 0 while the held-out eval does not improve. Otherwise the viability settings (KL 1.0, CE 0.8, L2-SP 0.05, AdamW lr 1e-4, clip 1.0, bf16 autocast, BN frozen, rel-pos patch) with SpecAugment off, the warmup capped at 10 % of the steps (100) and the cooldown over the last 20 %. The 8 GB RTX 4070 holds fp32 weights + grads (4.9 GB) but not AdamW's m, v: optim.offload cpu keeps them and the fp32 masters in host memory (~12 GB RAM). Measured on this laptop's CPU for the 616M trainable params (two runs, both while a teacher pass was running): AdamW foreach 1.2-1.6 s per step (the fused CPU kernel 0.5-0.6 s: --set optim.offload_fused=true), the L2-SP pull + its value in one pass ~0.9-1.4 s, plus ~0.4 s of PCIe copies: ~2.5-3.5 s per step with the tiny forward/backward. Expected wall time: 1000 x ~3 s steps (~50 min) + 1000 evals x ~1.5-2.5 s (~25-40 min) + setup and smoke (~5 min) + a full state (8.6 GB, ~10-30 s) after the smoke steps and every 10 min of loop time, the resume points scripts/supervise_distill.py relaunches from after a GPU fault (~2-5 min) = about 1.4-1.8 h, plus ~5-10 min per crash and resume.
